answer_2.quote: We evaluated the baseline models under two distinct prompting settings... The evaluation process adapts to various answer types within the dataset by employing tailored metrics and criteria for each specific answer type. Additionally, normalization was applied... For binary yes/no and integer count answers, we implemented an exact match criterion and accuracy as the evaluation metric. For single-word answers... we employed the recall metric... For list type answer, we used precision and recall metrics... We also evaluated other ranking metrics, including Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and Mean Average Precision (MAP), as detailed in Appendix C. ... Rank-wise Precision (RWP) method...
